observations.body: The vision gives glory, kingdom, and worldwide service to one coming with heaven’s clouds.
observations.label: Dominion given to one like a son of man

observations.body: The passage places Human kingdom beside dominion given to one like a son of man.
observations.label: Human kingdom

payload.posture: Read Daniel 7:12–28 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the vision gives glory, kingdom, and worldwide service to one coming with heaven’s clouds. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: Dominion given to one like a son of man
